blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createViewConfigurationWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow creates a view configuration, which stores the column visibility,
ordering, filters, and sorting preferences for an entity's data table in the
admin dashboard. If `set_active` is enabled and a `user_id` is provided, the
created configuration is also set as the user's active view for the entity.

This workflow is used by the [Create View Configuration](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#views\_postviewsentityconfigurations)
API route.

You can use this workflow within your own customizations or custom workflows,
allowing you to create a view configuration within your custom flows.

steps.name: setActiveViewConfigurationStep

This step sets a view configuration as the active view for a user and entity.
It compensates by restoring the user's previously active view, or clearing it
if there wasn't one.
